bibl.title: Low Prices and Unsettled Things in P.Princ. 3.188
bibl.seg: Nikos Litinas, Low Prices and Unsettled Things in P.Princ. 3.188.
bibl.note: Re-edition of P.Princ. 3.188, a private letter from a wife to her husband. It was assumed to concern household management and the abandoning of their child. Presents some new readings and comments on the new pieces of information concerning the context and the situation described.
